title: Jobs and incidents hide a degraded read and show a smaller total as fact
hosted_verification_note: Hosted verification was not run. Per the task brief, hosted verification is deferred to the operator acceptance task; only local functional and typecheck verification was executed.

acceptance_criteria.1_jobs_degraded_notice_plain_language_so: verified: usePagedOperationList in src/management/pages/Operations.tsx preserves ListEnvelope.meta on PagedPage<T>. JobsPage inspects extractDegradation(page?.meta) and extractDegradedSources(page?.meta) and renders OperationDegradedNotice (data-testid='ops-list-degraded-notice', role='status') stating that the list and total count are incomplete and naming degraded known sources (source_ingestion, research_orchestrator, research_worker_gateway, training_session, policy_learning) in plain language in both en-US and zh-TW without engineering terms, falling back to a generic sentence for unknown sources.
acceptance_criteria.2_healthy_sources_no_notice_unchanged_la: verified: When every source is healthy (meta.surfaces.job_list.status === 'ok' / meta.surfaces.incidents.status === 'ok'), extractDegradation returns { degraded: false }, neither OperationUnavailableState nor OperationDegradedNotice renders, and the DataTable + ServerPager layout is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.3_incidents_page_shows_same_degraded_not: verified: IncidentsPage shares usePagedOperationList and OperationDegradedNotice with JobsPage and renders the same notice when GET /bff/incidents returns a degraded envelope.
acceptance_criteria.4_degraded_with_page_token_past_reduced_: verified: When the envelope is degraded and the current page returns zero items (e.g. page_token='60' past reduced total 44), OperationDegradedNotice and ServerPager render while DataTable is hidden so no empty list message appears and the previous page control (jobs-page-prev / incidents-page-prev) remains enabled and navigates back.
acceptance_criteria.5_failed_read_shows_unavailable_with_ret: verified: usePagedOperationList configures useQuery with retry: false and exposes isError, error, and retry. When a read fails (isError or surface status 'unavailable'), JobsPage and IncidentsPage reuse OperationUnavailableState (matching AlertsPage's role='alert' card presentation) with a Retry button and cleaned reason, and never render an empty DataTable.
acceptance_criteria.6_row_content_paging_and_realtime_merge_: verified: Existing server paging and first-page-only realtime job merge behaviour are preserved and verified by all existing tests in src/management/pages/Operations.test.tsx.
acceptance_criteria.7_no_existing_test_weakened_or_deleted: verified: No existing test or assertion was weakened or deleted; 5 new tests covering AC1-AC6 with real BFF job and incident row shapes and envelopes were added to src/management/pages/Operations.test.tsx.

changed_assertions: None. All existing tests and assertions in Operations.test.tsx are preserved unchanged.
